news.title: Early-career researchers to be honored with 2026 Boeing Quantum Creators Prize
news.summary_en: Twelve early-career quantum researchers have been awarded the 2026 Boeing Quantum Creators Prize for work that moves the field of quantum information science and engineering in new directions.
